system.description:
This talent's effect occurs when the missile is shot, even if it misses the target. As it travels through the air, the missile produces a loud cry, causing all within 30' of its path to check morale. If the morale check is failed, the victims will retreat in fear for [[/r 1d8 #Feared rounds]] rounds.

Important: These missiles do not become nonmagical once used.

Ammunition for a crossbow. Sometimes called a bolt. These arrows are magical and provide a to-hit and damage bonus.
